Universal binaries (Apple silicon and Intel), ad-hoc signed for now.

| you are | download | then |
|---|---|---|
| a normal person | `Turn-Them-Off-*-macos-universal.zip` | unzip, drag to Applications, right-click, Open the first time |
| a terminal person | `tto-*-macos-universal.tar.gz` | put `tto` on your PATH; `sudo tto install`; `tto off tonight` |

Until Developer ID signing lands, Gatekeeper will object once. Right-click,
Open, and it will not mention it again. `SHA256SUMS` is there if you would
like to check what you are about to trust with your evenings.
